area: contracts: src/**, test/contracts/**, test/*.mjs, hardhat.config.cjs, config/**
summary:
Pixel Garden is an NFT-owned application environment. One ERC-721 'Garden' minted from PixelGardenKernel atomically receives two fixed ERC-6551 accounts: Reach (a bounded executor that can withdraw assets and run reviewed typed application calls) and Grip (a receive-only vault with no exit path). The kernel also freezes one immutable browser host (<=196,608-byte raw HTML archive) before the first mint and serves it via document(id)/tokenURI(id) as a data: URI plus a web3://<kernel>:<chain>/document/<id>/string!index.html address (ERC-4804/6860), keeps owner-controlled content and application catalogs with custody/activation/transfer epochs, append-only state archives per app namespace, permanent LP position records, and ownership-transition grants (succession, estate sale, rental pointer, non-shortenable transfer seal).

Extension is by 'cartridges': separate ERC-721 collections admitted by deployed-bytecode keccak (six constructor hashes plus four compiler-generated constants), never by address or admin. Ten families: 1 Market (Uniswap v3/v4 swaps, ETH/token v4 LP launches, vesting-sale and presale-launch entrypoints), 2 Locks (fixed-beneficiary vesting + beneficiary-authorized maturity sales), 3 Social (rooms, moderation, reactions, P-256 encrypted whispers, EIP-712 identity attestation with retirement), 4 Continuity (dead-man succession), 5 Estate (visual rentals + inventory-digest-bound Garden sale), 6 Presale (fixed-price ETH presale graduating into Market LP with buyer vesting), 7 Curve (ascending-price lot sale graduating into Liquidity LP), 8 Liquidity (sorted v4 pairs, v2 swaps, fee sharing with remainder carry), 9 Launchpad (CREATE2 fixed-supply ERC-20 minted to Reach and user-authored v4 hook deployment with flag verification), 10 OTC (named-party bundle escrow with broker fee). Families 1/2/6/7/8/9 are reachable only through ReachAccount.executeCartridge(Call) with at most two exact input allowances and two output floors, exact-delta reconciliation on both sides, allowance zeroing, ratcheting seals and exact-recipe session keys; families 3/4/5/10 have no Reach policy and authenticate the Garden owner directly with live custody and activation epochs.

The storage layer (ArchiveFactory, AppChunk, OnchainApp, OnchainAppDirectory) is content-addressed STOP-prefixed bytecode storage adapted from IPSEITY (CREATE2 salt = sha256(payload), dedupe, directory of up to 16 leaves x 32 chunks x 23,000 bytes, descriptors carrying stored/expanded hash + reader codehash, gzip verified client-side). Accounts are 'Inspired by IPSEITY-FINAL IpseityAccount/GripVault'. The web UI is delivered from chain; ownership is verified client-side by comparing the connected EIP-1193 account to ownerOf(tokenId) (plus isCanonicalAccount on both accounts) and enforced on-chain by owner+epoch checks in every mutating path; there is no login signature or server. Measured: 20 production artifacts all under EIP-170 (kernel 23,785/45,494 bytes, Market 24,340 runtime with 236 bytes headroom), host 196,543/196,608 bytes, 396 automated tests passing, fork evidence at Ethereum block 26,059,508. Predeployment, unaudited.

components.name: PixelGardenKernel
components.purpose: ERC-721 identity core: creates/verifies two ERC-6551 accounts per token in the mint hook, tracks custodyEpoch, freezes one immutable host archive and serves document()/tokenURI(), owner-controlled content and application catalogs with activation epochs, append-only state archives with atomic migration, permanent position records, family->action policy table, Continuity/Estate transfer grants, rental pointer and transfer seal.
key_functions: constructor(uint256 maxSupply_, ContentCartridge contentCartridges_, bytes32 applicationRuntimeHash_, bytes32 locksRuntimeHash_, bytes32 socialRuntimeHash_, bytes32 continuityRuntimeHash_, bytes32 estateRuntimeHash_, bytes32 presaleRuntimeHash_) (:157)
freezeHost(ArchiveTypes.Archive calldata) external (:229) — hostPublisher only, before first mint, raw, <=196608 bytes
document(uint256 id) public view returns (bytes) (:247) and document(uint256,string) (:244) — host bytes + PIXEL_CONTEXT script + </body></html>
runtimeFamily(address) returns uint8 1..10 by extcodehash (:504); applicationAction(address,uint8) returns policy 0/1/2 (:519)
authorizeContinuity / authorizeEstate / executeContinuity / executeEstate / reserveRental / sealTransfer (:653-746)

_beforeTokenTransfer (:773) rejects zero/self/implementation/own-account/any canonical account recipients, enforces seal and transition guards, ++custodyEpoch; _afterTokenTransfer (:748) creates both accounts via the canonical registry on mint
design_decisions: Constructor-pinned inventory: 1 = Market, 2 = Locks, 3 = Social. No admission setter. (:73)
One setup operation, forever closed by either publication or the first mint. An unhosted foundation fixture may mint, but cannot add a host afterward. (:226-227)
Receipt alone is inert. Only the ready Garden's current owner may activate content. (:330)
Every successful owner-controlled catalog mutation changes this inventory commitment. (:94)
Disallow parent-Garden nesting into deployed canonical accounts, including other Gardens. Unrelated wallets and undeployed foreign/counterfactual accounts cannot be universally classified. (:787-788)
ERC-6860 auto-mode uses the final string's .html suffix for MIME. (:242)
Nonfinancial application snapshots only; history cannot overwrite application escrow. (:427)
security_invariants: accounts created and codehash-verified before the ERC-721 receiver callback; accountReady only after full mint success; receiver rejection rolls back NFT, epoch and both account deployments
every owner-controlled mutation needs msg.sender == ownerOf (operators excluded), live custodyEpoch, accountReady, Reach not executing
custodyEpoch increments on every transfer; transfer-away-and-back never revives activations, grants or sessions
installation grants no spending; invalidateCartridge runs before Reach ERC-721 withdrawal
Gardens cannot be burned or sent to kernel, implementations, own accounts, or any deployed canonical account
only the exact granted family-4/5 application can move the Garden, with matching epoch and grant revision; nested transfers blocked while transition==2
selectedContent epoch invalidates sibling editions on release change
components.reuse_notes: Host-freeze + document() + epochs + catalogs are the 'mint a website' core; generalise the hard-coded ten-family admission (constructor array of hashes with a policy word), drop Uniswap-specific policy table, trim size (791 bytes headroom; initcode 45,494/49,152). Fix freezeHost/readAll schema-2 mismatch.

components.name: AccountBinding
components.purpose: ERC-6551 constants and math: registry 0x000000006551c19487814612e58FE06813775758 with pinned codehash 0xda1d5b06...6735, salts keccak256('pixel.garden.reach.v1'/'pixel.garden.grip.v1'), ERC-1167+footer runtime builder, CREATE2 prediction, footer parser (only for 173-byte code).
design_decisions: A reported token() or owner() is never sufficient; the kernel compares predicted address and exact runtime keccak
security_invariants: identity derives only from implementation+salt+chain+collection+id and the registry's exact bytecode
components.reuse_notes: Requires the canonical registry at that address with that codehash on every target chain.

components.name: GardenAccount + GripAccount
components.purpose: Abstract ERC-6551 account base (token(), owner() returning zero for unready/forged/wrong-chain, ERC-1271 always 0xffffffff, isValidSigner only for Reach owner, 721/1155 receivers) and the receive-only Grip vault whose only extra function is state()->0.
design_decisions: Fail closed until a separately reviewed, epoch-bound signature schema exists. (GardenAccount:32)
Permanent receiving-only custody. No execution, approvals, exits, upgrades or spending signatures. (GripAccount:6)
Inspired by IPSEITY-FINAL IpseityAccount/GripVault (GardenAccount:7)
security_invariants: Grip has no outbound selector at all; tests call withdraw*/execute/approve/setApprovalForAll/upgradeTo/rescue and assert revert
components.reuse_notes: Grip IS the GOAL's vault. Consider enabling an epoch-bound ERC-1271 later.

components.name: ReachAccount
components.purpose: Bounded executor: typed ETH/ERC-20/ERC-721/ERC-1155 withdrawals with exact deltas, ratcheting per-asset/global seals, exact-recipe session keys (hash of the full Call, 1..1024 uses), executeCartridge (policy-gated typed application call with <=2 exact inputs / <=2 output floors and allowance zeroing) and owner-only atomic executeSwapToLock.
key_functions: withdrawETH(address payable,uint256,uint256 epoch) / withdrawERC20 / withdrawERC721 / withdrawERC1155 (:119-181)
sealAsset(uint8 kind,address asset,uint256 tokenId,uint64 until,uint256 epoch) / sealAll(uint64,uint256) (:191-213)
grantSession(address key,bytes32 recipe,uint64 expires,uint32 uses,uint256 epoch) / revokeSession (:218-242)
executeSwapToLock(Call swap, LockTarget target) returns (uint256 scheduleId) (:315)
_perform: data cap 2048 (12288 for families 1/6/7/8, 50176 for 9), sorted unique <=2 assets each side, disjoint, exact approve then zero and verify (:389-449)
design_decisions: One reviewed runtime interface, at most two exact input allowances and two output bounds. Does not accept arbitrary selectors/targets. Settlement uses permanent position rights. (:256-257)
No general batch executor or session grant. Both pinned families must remain active. (:314)
security_invariants: only ownerOf(id) at live custodyEpoch may withdraw/seal/grant; sessions bound to recipe hash, custody epoch, revision, expiry and uses; seals ratchet forward; allowances never persist; isExecuting guard blocks reentry and parent transfer during execution
components.reuse_notes: Keep the executor/seal/session model; add epoch-bound ERC-1271 if venues need account signatures; consider >2 assets for LP seeding.

components.name: ArchiveFactory + AppChunk + OnchainApp + OnchainAppDirectory + ArchiveTypes
components.purpose: Content-addressed immutable bytecode storage: AppChunk = 0x00 + payload (1..23,000 B) deployed by CREATE2 with salt sha256(payload); OnchainApp = up to 32 chunks with in-place sha256 verification and readAll; OnchainAppDirectory = up to 16 leaves (pinned, not computed digest, readChunk only); ArchiveFactory = permissionless creation, dedupe, and validateArchive(descriptor{archive,schema,compression,storedHash,storedBytes,expandedHash,expandedBytes,codeHash}).
key_functions: OnchainAppDirectory.readChunk(i) re-verifies leaf codehash and metadata
design_decisions: Hash the assembled bytes in place. Solidity's sha256(bytes) path can allocate another complete input buffer; at 1 MiB its quadratic memory cost prevents a maximum-size cartridge retaining wallet gas headroom. (OnchainApp:39-41)
SHA-256 leaf digests cannot establish the concatenated digest. This directory pins that expected digest; readers MUST verify the complete recovered bytes before execution. (OnchainAppDirectory:13-15)
Canonical immutable archives; adapted from IPSEITY ModuleArchiveFactory. No administrator, mutable reader, or upgrade path. Hashes identify bytes, not safe code. (ArchiveFactory:14-15)
security_invariants: chunk reuse re-verifies codehash; descriptor must match reader codehash, stored hash/length, compression<=1, expanded<=16 MiB; raw descriptors must have stored==expanded
components.reuse_notes: Add readAll to directories (or restrict host to schema 1); optionally replace require strings with custom errors.

components.name: ContentCartridge
components.purpose: ERC-721 'Pixel Garden Cartridges'/SEED: immutable releases (publisher, appKey, stateSchema, content+manifest archives) and transferable editions bound to a release; starter opt-in; transferEpoch per edition; UTF-8 name validation; builds the kernel's tokenURI JSON.
key_functions: publish(bytes32 appKey,bytes32 stateSchema,Archive content,Archive manifest) returns bytes32 releaseId
design_decisions: Percent-encode the small JSON envelope once. The base64 HTML alphabet is URI-safe. Re-encoding the entire HTML a second time would exceed ordinary RPC gas caps. (:89-90)
Detects transfer away and back even if custody later matches. (:198)
constructor requires factory.codehash == keccak256(type(ArchiveFactory).runtimeCode)
security_invariants: releaseId commits to chain, collection, publisher, appKey, schema and both descriptors; only the publisher mints; opt-in is irreversible
components.reuse_notes: Keep release/edition/starter model; rewrite metadata builder for the unified token.

components.name: OpenEditionNFT + RuntimeNFT
components.purpose: Shared bases for application NFTs: irreversible free starter editions with sentinel reservation before safeMint; RuntimeNFT adds garden/contentCollection/publisher/releaseId/chainId binding, guarded reentry+chain modifier, _authorize(id, Call, settlement) (caller must be the canonical executing Reach, live epoch, active edition), exact _pull/_send.
design_decisions: Reserve before safeMint's callback. Reentry into the same claim must fail (ownerOf the sentinel), never create a second starter edition. (OpenEditionNFT:29-30)
Common immutable NFT identity and exact-asset boundaries. No generic executor. (RuntimeNFT:14)
security_invariants: editions cannot transfer while a runtime call is in progress; only the release publisher may deploy the runtime
components.reuse_notes: Base for every app NFT.

components.name: MarketCartridge (family 1)
components.purpose: Swaps and launches: action 1 Uniswap v3 SwapRouter02 exactInput (path 43..112 bytes), action 2 v4 exact-input swap via unlock/unlockCallback with commitment, action 3 ETH/token v4 LP seed through PositionManager+Permit2 (actions 0x020d14), action 4 position exit/fee collect (0x0111) after unlockAt; contract-only executeVestingSale (from Locks) and executePresaleLaunch (from Presale) gated by commitment handshakes.
key_functions: execute(uint256 gardenId, Call) payable returns positionId (:165)
design_decisions: Constructor-only configuration, no delegatecall, arbitrary router commands, rescue or upgrades. (:30)
Preserve preexisting balances, return unused inputs, then remit observed outputs to Reach. (:223)
Permit2 normalizes an input expiry of zero to the current block timestamp. (:622)
A vesting sale consumes exactly its authorized balance; v4 partial fills revert. (:286)
security_invariants: caller must be canonical executing Reach; exact deltas on inputs/outputs; allowances zero before and after; unlockCallback only from poolManager with matching commitment; receive() only from weth/poolManager/positionManager while entered; exits need kernel.settlementAllowed and unlockAt
components.reuse_notes: At 24,340 bytes (236 headroom): split v3 and v4 or merge with Liquidity; keep unlock-commitment and exact-delta remittance patterns.

components.name: LocksCartridge (family 2)
components.purpose: Non-cancellable fixed-beneficiary ETH/ERC-20 vesting (start/cliff/end, floor pro-rata, permissionless claim to the fixed beneficiary) plus beneficiary-authorized maturity sales executed by any gas payer through a pinned Market with commitment handshake.
design_decisions: Editions authorize new allocations only. Anyone can trigger a payout to the bound beneficiary. (:18)
Reserve entitlement and revision before tokens, protocols or recipients can call back. (:244)
Status: 0 absent, 1 authorized, 2 cancelled, 3 pre-empted by claim, 4 settled, 5 replaced. (:45)
security_invariants: escrowed[asset] solvency before/after payouts; direct claim pre-empts sales; sale output goes only to the beneficiary; software removal or Garden sale cannot redirect
components.reuse_notes: Vesting primitive for launchpad allocations; maturity-sale extension optional.

components.name: SocialCartridge (family 3)
components.purpose: Nonfinancial social runtime: public Commons (room 0) and founder-owned rooms (invite-only, close, cooldown, replies-only, moderator/ban policies bound to epochs), posts (<=2048 bytes, parent threads, hide flag), reactions, epoch-scoped blocks, P-256 public key registry per custody epoch, encrypted whispers (<=4096-byte envelopes, dedupe, mailbox indexes), EIP-712 identity attestation with owner-only retirement and verifyIdentity (EOA or ERC-1271).
design_decisions: Records are public and append-only. Encryption and key backups happen in the trusted browser. (:11)
Room zero is the public Commons. No moderator can close or erase it. (:127)
Epoch in the identity prevents a reaction being attributed to a future owner. (:395)
Read-only EIP-712 identity attestation; never a transaction or spending grant. (:449)
Revocation remains owner-controlled without an active software edition. (:483)
security_invariants: every write needs ownerOf + live custodyEpoch + active edition (operators excluded); memberships/policies bind both member and founder epochs; keys from old epochs are unusable; retirement is permanent
components.reuse_notes: Richest messaging/crypto-social layer across the repos; move bodies/envelopes to events with on-chain indexes to cut gas; keep key registry and identity attestation.

components.name: ContinuityCartridge (family 4)
components.purpose: Revocable dead-man succession: owner arranges heir (wallet or current holder of another Garden), quiet 30-3650 days then heir notice 7-365 days; explicit owner checkIn resets; heir claim calls kernel.executeContinuity under a separate kernel grant; status machine 0..6 including transfer-seal state.
design_decisions: Owner check-in is explicit. Deposits, sessions, reads and other parties cannot reset it. (:187)
A separate kernel grant is required. No Reach spending or ERC-721 operator grant is created. (:17)
security_invariants: plan binds custody epoch and grant revision; heir-Garden custody epoch recorded at notice; claim disables plan before transfer
components.reuse_notes: Optional but cheap (8,796 bytes) differentiator.

components.name: EstateCartridge (family 5)
components.purpose: Paid visual-trait rentals (kernel rental pointer, exact prepaid ceil pricing, floor-earned accrual, trait mask) and inventory-bound Garden sale: listing commits to inventoryDigest (custodyEpoch, catalogRevision, Reach.state, transferSealUntil, continuity grant+plan hash, rental digest, offer) plus up to 64 holding floors across Reach/Grip; buy() re-checks standing before and after payment then calls kernel.executeEstate; pull-payment credits.
design_decisions: Catalog revisions bind every selected release/head and owner-controlled core change. Reach's monotonic state binds all seals, sessions and typed actions. Balances are explicit floors. (:353-354)
exact recheck after any payment-token callback (:475)
security_invariants: sale requires separate kernel estateApproval with matching epoch/revision; payment-token callbacks cannot mutate inventory; liability accounting; fixed recipients survive software removal
components.reuse_notes: Reuse the inventory-digest sale for a vault-bearing NFT; drop the crystal-trait rental half. Decouple from concrete PixelGardenKernel import.

components.name: PresaleCartridge (family 6)
components.purpose: Fully escrowed fixed-price ETH presale of an existing ERC-20: inventory + separate LP token reserve pulled from Reach at creation; incremental floor allocation per wallet; finalize by anyone at hard cap or after close (>= soft cap) through Market.executePresaleLaunch with commitment; fail/cancel/refund; buyer vesting (start/cliff/end) and fixed-recipient remainders.
key_functions: execute action 1 with Terms (nonce, inventory, rate, caps, times, vesting, recipients, market, Presales.Seed, document)
design_decisions: Buyer claims/refunds are fixed; LP rights follow the Garden. Installation only permits creation. (:20)
Anyone can launch only the immutable recipe. Failure rolls back all state and approvals. (:312)
allocation = floor(cumulative wei * num/den) minus previous allocation to remove partition rounding
security_invariants: ETH raised = LP ETH + proceeds credit; funded tokens = LP tokens + allocations + unused credit; aggregate escrow solvency per asset; receive() only from executingMarket with live launchContext
components.reuse_notes: Launchpad fixed-price sale; generalise quote asset and venue binding.

components.name: CurveCartridge (family 7)
components.purpose: Escrow-backed buy-only ascending-price lot sale (cost = basePrice*n + slope*n(n-1)/2) in ETH or an ERC-20 quote, graduating into a Liquidity v4 position via commitment handshake; refunds on failure; vesting and fixed-recipient remainders.
design_decisions: Buy-only bootstrap: no prelaunch resale, virtual reserves, issuance or mutable terms. Failed sales refund each buyer's exact paid quote; launched allocations remain fixed claims. (:14-15)
security_invariants: quoteMax <= cumulativeCost(minLots); escrow solvency; approvals cleared and verified after graduate
components.reuse_notes: Safe bonding-curve-like launch without sell side; pairs with Liquidity.

components.name: LiquidityCartridge (family 8)
components.purpose: Sorted ETH/ERC-20 or ERC-20/ERC-20 v4 LP seeding with permissionless hooks, Permit2 approve/clear verification, locked principal, two-step exit (zero-liquidity decrease collects fees first, feeShareBps credited to feeRecipient with mulmod remainder carry), Uniswap v2 exact-input swaps (path 2..5), graduate() entrypoint for Curve.
design_decisions: Permissionless hook selection; no arbitrary commands, LP transfers, upgrade or rescue authority. (:22)
constructor verifies router.WETH()==weth and positionManager/stateView.poolManager()==poolManager
security_invariants: _available = balance - feeLiability; fee credits only from collected fees; principal only after unlockAt; onERC721Received only from positionManager while entered
components.reuse_notes: Most general LP primitive; merge with Market's native path.

components.name: LaunchpadCartridge + LaunchToken (family 9)
components.purpose: Action 1 deploys a fixed-supply OZ ERC-20 (name<=64, symbol<=16, decimals<=18) by CREATE2 with all supply minted to the Garden's Reach; action 2 deploys user-authored Uniswap v4 hook initcode (<=49,152 bytes) by CREATE2 with on-chain check that the low 14 address bits equal the declared flags and HookConfig.flagsValid; per-Garden nonce reservation before create2; permanent Deployment records.
design_decisions: User initcode runs in its new contract, never by delegatecall in Garden custody. (:9)
Reserve before constructor execution. Every external runtime entry remains guarded. (:129)
Deployments are catalogued here; they are not LP settlement positions. (:148)
security_invariants: created == predicted and has code; constructor ETH bounded by the single native spend; leftover returned; constructor callbacks cannot reenter (guarded)
components.reuse_notes: Exactly the launchpad 'create token'; hook deployment is a differentiator.

components.name: OTCCartridge (family 10)
components.purpose: Garden-owner-brokered named-party bundle escrow: up to 8 assets per side (ETH/ERC-20/ERC-721/ERC-1155), optional broker fee on one side, each party funds its own side against the exact terms hash, anyone settles atomically once both funded, cancel/expiry/refund per side independently, broker credit pull.
design_decisions: Once a party funds, the broker cannot unilaterally cancel its agreement. (:282)
Check only this side: a broken counterparty token must not prevent independent refunds. (:307)
Funding transfers each explicitly reviewed asset separately. (:357)
security_invariants: receipt-bound onERC721Received/onERC1155Received (keccak(kind,token,from,id,amount)) and operator==this; per-asset liability solvency; fee credited only on settlement
components.reuse_notes: P2P 'social trading' escrow that complements rooms/whispers.

components.name: Interfaces (Applications, HookConfig, Markets, Liquidity, Presales, VestingSales)
components.purpose: ApplicationTypes.Call{application,edition,action,custodyEpoch,activationEpoch,deadline,spend[],receiveMin[],data} and IApplicationNFT/IApplicationKernel; HookConfig 14-bit flag validation with the four v4 return-delta prerequisites and fee/dynamic-fee rules; minimal Uniswap v3/v4/Permit2/WETH ABIs; Seed structs and domain-separated commitment() helpers ('pixel.curve.graduation/1', 'pixel.presale.launch/1', 'pixel.garden.vesting-sale/1').
design_decisions: Protocol encoding checks only. There is no publisher or hook allowlist. (HookConfig:4)
security_invariants: commitments bind chain, kernel, caller, ids, full terms and deadline
components.reuse_notes: Applications/HookConfig/Markets verbatim; rename commitment domains.

components.name: Generated pins
components.purpose: Compiler-written constants: ContentRuntimeHash.VALUE 0x4e5d1914...0554; ExtensionRuntimeHashes Curve 0x249261b0...34f2, Liquidity 0x15fd0eb8...69e2, Launchpad 0xeb311dd1...bb68, OTC 0x54bd9cd5...b166; the kernel embeds them so admission of these families is baked into kernel bytecode.
design_decisions: Generated from the exact production compiler/settings; no mutable admission registry.
security_invariants: compile.mjs asserts the final build's deployed bytecode hashes equal the pins
components.reuse_notes: Regenerate for any new build.

components.name: Vendor ERC721 + Base64
components.purpose: Solady ERC721 (storage hitchhiking, _before/_afterTokenTransfer hooks) and Solady Base64; LibString/SafeTransferLib come from the solady npm package 0.1.26, ERC20/Math/SignatureChecker from OpenZeppelin 5.4.0.
components.reuse_notes: MIT.

components.name: PixelGarden (legacy monolith) and research/PixelGarden.extended.sol.txt
components.purpose: Superseded single-contract build: per-Garden treasury ledgers, storage-chunked releases (4,096-byte chunks, 262,144-byte packages), freezeHost, install/writeState, vesting, v3/v4 swaps (no hooks), ETH/token v4 launches, document() with context before host bytes, base64 tokenURI with SVG image. 24,331 bytes; extended candidate was 27,302 (over limit).
design_decisions: No CREATE/CREATE2, proxy, delegatecall or generic executor. (:21)
components.reuse_notes: Every idea migrated to kernel + cartridges; keep only as a reference for the one-contract size trade-off.

components.name: Test-support contracts
components.purpose: Adversarial fixtures: taxed MockToken, MockRouter, ForgedAccount, AccountReceiver (mint/transfer/spend reentry from onERC721Received), ReentryRouter (parent transfer + over-spend from router callback), SwapLockAdversary (callback + escrow-only tax), EstateAdversary (transferFrom callback + nested transfer), OTCReceiver/OTCBurnToken, PresaleBuyerFixture, LaunchHookFixture (afterSwap return-delta fee; EmptyCreationFixture; ConstructorReentryFixture), MultiAssetPoolFixture/PresalePoolFixture/SalePoolFixture (v4/Permit2 models), ENSFixture, LocksReceiver, SaleReceiver, SaleLossToken.
design_decisions: Disposable accounting model; never counted as real-protocol evidence. (MultiAssetPoolFixture:5)
components.reuse_notes: Port the reentry/taxed/forged/receipt-bound fixtures to the unified suite.

standards_implemented: ERC-721 (Solady implementation) for the Garden collection and every cartridge collection

ERC-6551 token-bound accounts via the canonical registry singleton (0x000000006551c19487814612e58FE06813775758), ERC-1167 forwarders with 96-byte footer, account interface id 0x6faff5f1, isValidSigner magic 0x523e3260
ERC-1271 present but deliberately failing closed (0xffffffff) on both accounts; verified on owners via OZ SignatureChecker in SocialCartridge.verifyIdentity
EIP-712 identity attestation (domain 'Pixel Garden Identity' v1)
ERC-4804 / ERC-6860 web3:// address in metadata and document(uint256,string) auto-mode MIME hint

Uniswap v3 SwapRouter02 exactInput, Uniswap v4 PoolManager unlock/swap/sync/settle/take, PositionManager modifyLiquidities (MINT_POSITION/SETTLE_PAIR/SWEEP/DECREASE_LIQUIDITY/TAKE_PAIR), StateView, v4 hook address-flag scheme, Permit2 allowance transfer, WETH9, Uniswap v2 Router swapExactTokensForTokens
unique_ideas: Two canonical ERC-6551 accounts per NFT (Reach executor + Grip receive-only vault) whose identity is verified by predicted address AND exact runtime keccak, never by a reported token()

Epoch triple: custodyEpoch (per Garden, bumps every transfer), activationEpoch (per installation) and transferEpoch (per edition); all grants/sessions/memberships/plans pin them so transfer-away-and-back never revives authority
Cartridge admission by deployed-bytecode keccak pinned at kernel construction (plus compiler-generated constants); family -> action policy table; cartridges are NFTs held in your own account

Single typed execute(gardenId, Call) ABI with <=2 exact input allowances and <=2 output floors, exact-delta reconciliation on both Reach and cartridge, allowance zeroing, and data-length caps per family
Exact-recipe session keys: hash of the full Call bound to chain/Reach/custody epoch with revision, expiry and use count; failed executions restore uses
Ratcheting one-way seals (per-asset, global, transfer seal) as owner commitments that survive sale
Commitment handshake between cooperating immutable cartridges (launchContext/saleContext set by caller, recomputed by callee, receive() gated on executingMarket)
Host frozen before first mint; document() appends PIXEL_CONTEXT after the archive; percent-encoded JSON data URI with base64 animation_url to avoid double base64 (RPC gas)

Content-addressed STOP-prefixed chunks with CREATE2 salt = sha256(payload), dedupe with codehash re-check, directories with pinned (not computed) digest, descriptors with stored/expanded hash + reader codehash, gzip verified client-side
Append-only state namespaces keyed by (collection, publisher, appKey, stateSchema) with CAS revisions, selection epochs and atomic migrateState

Social: per-epoch P-256 key registry, epoch-scoped blocks, dedupe of whisper envelopes, Commons room 0 unclosable, EIP-712 identity attestation with owner-retirable digests usable after software removal
Estate inventory-digest sale: listing commits to catalogRevision, Reach.state, seals, grants and balance floors across both accounts, re-checked before and after payment
OTC receipt-bound safe-transfer callbacks and per-side independent refunds; broker fee only on settlement

Presale incremental floor allocation (kills within-wallet partition rounding); Curve closed-form cumulative pricing; Liquidity fee share with mulmod remainder carry and fee-first zero-liquidity decrease
CREATE2 hook deployment with on-chain verification that the address's low 14 bits equal the declared v4 flags, per-Garden nonce reserved before create2
OpenEditionNFT starter claims with type(uint256).max sentinel reservation before safeMint
Compiler pipeline that regenerates runtime-hash constants from the exact production settings and asserts the final build matches (tools/compile.mjs)
weaknesses: Size: kernel 23,785/24,576 runtime and 45,494/49,152 initcode; MarketCartridge 24,340 (236 bytes headroom); no room to add features without splitting
Fixed family inventory baked into the kernel (6 constructor hashes + 4 compiled constants); a new family requires a new kernel and host freeze; existing Gardens cannot adopt it

website_delivery: From chain. The host is one self-contained HTML (dist/kernel-host.html, <=196,608 bytes: minified CSS + bundled JS gzipped and radix-85 encoded inside a bootstrap that waits for DOMContentLoaded, decodes, DecompressionStream('gzip'), and injects the script) published as a raw ArchiveFactory archive and pinned once by PixelGardenKernel.freezeHost before the first mint. document(id) returns archive.readAll() + '<script>window.PIXEL_CONTEXT={"chainId","contract","tokenId"}</script></body></html>'; tokenURI(id) returns data:application/json,<percent-encoded JSON> with animation_url=data:text/html;base64,<document> and external_url=web3://<kernel>:<chainId>/document/<id>/string!index.html (ERC-4804/6860; document(uint256,string) supplies the .html MIME hint). Each app (Market UI, Social UI, Studio, etc.) is a separate archived release recovered from ArchiveFactory chunks at a pinned block with stored/expanded sha256 and reader-codehash verification, then run in an opaque-origin sandbox='allow-scripts' iframe with a CSP that denies network; nine 'trusted' native workspaces must also match build-time sha256 pins compiled into the host. No server, no IPFS, no indexer: all reads are eth_call/eth_getLogs. Optional convenience: tools/build-launcher.mjs emits an HTTPS reader (dist/launcher.html) that recovers the frozen host from chain and refuses any host whose expandedHash differs from the build pin; it never executes metadata animation_url. MINT-TO-APP.md notes native web3:// clients still need wallet injection, origin storage, Web Locks and DecompressionStream, so the HTTPS reader is 'the tested compatibility route'.
wallet_gating: No login signature, no server session. web/kernel/client.mjs initialize() checks provider chainId == PIXEL_CONTEXT.chainId and kernel.deploymentChainId(); refresh() reads ownerOf(tokenId), custodyEpoch, account(), grip(), accountReady, displayName, visualSeed and throws 'Account binding failed' unless isCanonicalAccount holds for both accounts. connect() uses EIP-1193 eth_requestAccounts (eth_accounts for silent reconnect; EIP-6963 discovery in the launcher; @metamask/connect-evm 2.1.1 for mobile), requires the wallet chain to match, then owns = connectedAccount == ownerOf(tokenId). The host shows 'OWNER CONNECTED' vs 'PUBLIC VIEW · EPOCH n', disables every owner control when !owns, and client.send() with ownerRequired throws 'Only the current Garden owner can do this' and re-checks owner and custody epoch immediately before the wallet prompt; account/chain changes clear signing state and close apps. Authoritative enforcement is on-chain: kernel _controller (msg.sender == ownerOf, live custodyEpoch, accountReady, Reach idle), ReachAccount.authorized (owner + epoch), Social._auth / Estate._owner / OTC.propose (owner + epoch + active edition); ERC-721 operators are excluded everywhere; cartridge-specific roles (session keys, beneficiaries, named OTC parties, heirs, renters, buyers) are checked by their own contracts. Public read-only use needs no wallet (any RPC). For off-chain verifiers, SocialCartridge.identityDigest/verifyIdentity provides an EIP-712 'Identity' attestation bound to kernel, Garden, custody epoch, purpose, challenge and deadline, retirable by the owner. Public website bytes are not private NFT content; ownership gates management, not reading.
